context: Five media-bearing errors from the link-enriched baseline, with source bio included in every treatment.

optionalSearch.failure: Qwen did not search the João Neves row and confidently misidentified him as an FC Barcelona player.

forcedSearch.failure: Search results encouraged an unsupported FC Barcelona transfer narrative for a generic Kylian Mbappé World Cup post.

observations: Optional search can trigger, but Qwen's confidence is not a reliable search gate.
The model issued multiple provider-executed searches despite being instructed to search at most or exactly once.
Forced search corrected the missed João Neves identity but did not improve aggregate accuracy over optional search on this five-row diagnostic set.
